dialog.speaker: partner
dialog.en: You're asleep. I'm changing the channel.

dialog.speaker: partner
dialog.tr: "İzliyorum" dedin, gözün kapalı. Ne izliyorsun peki?
dialog.en: "I'm watching," you said, eyes shut. Watching what, exactly?

inkar.tr: "Dinliyordum" dedin. Son haberi sordu, hava durumunu anlattın. Ekranda spor vardı.
inkar.en: "I was listening," you said. Asked for the last story, you gave the weather. The screen was showing sports.

coach.en: The forecast was accurate. The channel was not.

yat.tr: Yatağa gittin. Yatakta uykun açıldı, yarım saat tavana baktın.
yat.en: You went to bed. In bed you were wide awake. You looked at the ceiling for half an hour.

coach.en: The sleep stayed in the armchair.

ver.tr: Kumandayı verdin. Bir dizi açtı, beş dakika sonra o da uyuyordu.
ver.en: You handed over the remote. They put on a series. Five minutes later they were asleep too.

coach.en: The television watched the two of you.

intent.setup: akşam haberlerinde koltukta uyuyup izlediğini iddia etmek
intent.mechanism: uyuyan kişi izlediği programı anlatmak zorunda kalıyor
